name: Insider Threat and Privileged Access Abuse
description: Responds to alerts indicating insider threat behaviour or privileged access abuse. Collects audit logs for the user, checks for abnormal access patterns (off-hours, mass downloads, unusual destinations), temporarily elevates monitoring, and escalates to HR and legal if evidence warrants.

triggers.name: UEBA / SIEM Alert
triggers.description: Receives insider threat or anomalous user behaviour alert from UEBA or SIEM

actions.name: Parse Alert
actions.description: Extract user, anomaly type, time window, risk score, accessed resources

actions.name: Collect 30-Day Audit Log
actions.description: Pull last 30 days of user audit events from SIEM for baseline comparison

actions.name: Review User Privileges
actions.description: List all AD group memberships and privileged roles for the user

actions.name: Enable Enhanced Monitoring
actions.description: Add user to enhanced monitoring watchlist for 30 days

actions.name: Create Restricted Case
actions.description: Create a restricted-access case visible only to senior analysts and legal

actions.name: Notify Security Lead Only
actions.description: Notify only the security lead - do NOT alert the general SOC or the user

parameters.name: subject
parameters.value: CONFIDENTIAL: Insider threat alert requires review

parameters.name: body
parameters.value: Risk score: $node_parse_alert.risk_score. User: $node_parse_alert.username. Case: $node_create_restricted_case.id. Please review before taking action.
